args.subject: Book Club Invitation — Tuesdays at 7 PM
args.body:
Hi Henry,

I'd like to invite you to our book club. We meet on Tuesday evenings at 7:00 PM at the local library. We're currently reading mystery novels and would love to have you join us.

Please let me know if you can make it or if you have any questions. Hope to see you there!

Best regards,

args.subject: Recommendation: The Artisan Bakery downtown
args.body:
Hi Alice,

I wanted to recommend The Artisan Bakery downtown — their sourdough is incredible. They bake fresh every morning at 6:00 AM, so it's perfect if you want to pick up a warm loaf early. Highly recommended!

Best,

args.subject: Invitation: Hands-on Italian Cooking Class — Wednesday evening next week
args.body:
Hi Bob,

I hope you’re well. I wanted to invite you to a hands-on Italian cuisine cooking class at the Culinary Arts Center next week. It’s on Wednesday evening and will focus on classic Italian dishes — a fun, practical session for all skill levels.

Would you be interested in joining? Please let me know if you can make it and I’ll share any additional details (time, cost, and registration) if needed.

Best,
[Your Name]

args.subject: Recommendation: Rachel — Yoga Instructor at the Community Center
args.body:
Hi Charlie,

I wanted to recommend Rachel — she's an excellent yoga instructor who teaches at the community center on Tuesdays and Thursdays. She's great with students of all levels and runs well-structured, engaging classes.

If you'd like her contact details or want me to introduce you, I can do that.

Best regards,

args.subject: Invitation: Tuesday Book Club (7 PM at the Local Library)
args.body:
Hi Alice,

I'd like to invite you to our book club meeting on Tuesday evenings. We meet at 7:00 PM at the local library, and we're currently reading mystery novels. We'd love to have you join us.

Hope you can make it—please let me know if you'd like more details.

Best,
